text: The standard n-simplex Δ[n] in sSet is the simplicial set represented by [n]:
choices: its k-simplices are all order-preserving maps [k] → [n]
explanation: Δ[n] = Hom_Δ(−, [n]): the representable presheaf on [n]. Its k-simplices are monotone maps [k]→[n]. By Yoneda, maps Δ[n]→X correspond to n-simplices of X.
